results.title: Rockstar
results.overview: Agun overcomes his childhood stage fright to become a world-famous rockstar. But with fame comes addiction, heartbreak, imprisonment, and the devastating loss of his voice. Supported by Aslam's friendship and Meera's love, he struggles to rebuild his life, only to be shattered once again by another tragic incident.

results.title: Silas and the Polar Bear on Table Mountain
results.original_title: Silas en die Ysbeer op Tafelberg
results.overview: Eight-year-old Silas lives with his mother and beloved grandmother at the foot of Table Mountain, where stories of Dreamland capture his imagination. After Grandma’s sudden death, Silas refuses to accept this loss and believes she simply got lost in Dreamland. He goes to Dreamland to look for her, but it doesn’t seem like he remembers it anymore. It feels like he’s just walking in circles. Meanwhile, the neighbors’ fearless daughter, Willemien, and a strange creature named Brommel unexpectedly appear at his side, and a terrifying polar bear begins to hunt them.

results.title: Kylgor in the Grisly Abyss
results.overview: Kylgor and his band of fellow survivors set out for revenge and to behead the Evil King Kath but unexpectedly plummet into the Grisly Abyss.

results.title: Second Case of Seetharam
results.overview: Inspector Seetharam, hoping to reunite with his estranged sister after years apart, must track down a brutal, psychotic serial killer terrorising the town of Anegadde.

results.title: Father's Day
results.overview: Tinke, who has been drinking his health away, lives in a care home, where his dark humour and his friend Veikko keeps him going. When Saimi's teenage twins, whom he vaguely remembers from years ago, decide to find out about their father, their search leads them to Tinke. Saimi is determined to prevent the twins from meeting Tinke, but Veikko, who has been caught up in the mess, disagrees.

results.title: Brailled It
results.overview: Blind and low-vision kids take control of the cameras and capture their own experiences at the annual Braille Challenge — a weekend of high-pressure competition and raw coming-of-age moments.

results.title: Don't Forget the Sunshine
results.overview: After six years in Germany, Maria gradually loses touch with who she is, trapped between the routine of her work and the intensity of her nights in the techno scene. When her ailing mother and older brother come to visit from Greece for the first time, old wounds reopen and long-suppressed conflicts rise to the surface. Caught between her life in the Ruhr region and her ties to Thessaloniki, Maria is forced to confront her family’s past and search for her own identity.

results.title: The Landlord
results.overview: After a painful breakup, middle-aged Stella sleeps with her new, young tenant, Anton. When he rejects her, she spirals into obsession, guilt and longing, until she learns that only by embracing the humiliation can she reclaim freedom.

results.title: Juvenescence
results.overview: An Australian coming of age comedy follows four teenagers navigating their final days at Edgewater High and all that comes with it.

results.title: Los niños
results.overview: Taking as its starting point the discovery of the bodies of the children of Llullaillaco and the debates that their discovery sparked, the central objective of the project is to question how the influence of the Inca Empire in the region was ignored during the geopolitical, cultural, and social formation of our country. An essayistic approach that, from a variety of perspectives, enables reflection on some of the identity contradictions that still underlie the idea of nationhood today.

results.title: Stream of Terror
results.overview: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

results.title: You Believe in Angels, Mr. Drowak?
results.original_title: Sie glauben an Engel, Herr Drowak?
results.overview: Lena is a cheerful student who firmly believes in happiness and the good in people. As part of a social project, she is sent by the office as a writing coach to Hugo Drowak, who has long since lost his luck and lives alone in a run-down tower block.

results.title: Calendar
results.overview: A retired workaholic tries to put new meaning into his days. He comes across his wife’s tear-off calendar, with birthdays of friends and relatives marked. Calling people long since forgotten leads to consequences no one could have guessed.

results.title: Jacky
results.overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

results.title: Unleashed Spirits: The Rise of the Hollywood Vampires
results.original_title: Unleashed Spirits: The Rise of the Hollywood Vampires
results.overview: A documentary explores the formation and journey of the rock supergroup, the Hollywood Vampires.

results.title: Silent Partner
results.overview: A Black couple's strength is tested when the ambitious husband, a star defense attorney at a white-shoe law firm, is thrust into a controversial, high-profile criminal case that has captured the attention of the nation.

results.title: Love, Sex and Elections
results.overview: Martin is a casting agent for adult films. One night in a club, he discovers the perfect candidate for his new role — Dasha, a party girl with remarkable acting potential. After a successful first shoot, however, it turns out that Dasha is the wife of the local mayor. Now Martin must worry not only about his career and life but also about the upcoming election.

results.title: The Arrow at Rest at Every Instant of its Flight
results.original_title: The Arrow at Rest at Every Instant of its Flight
results.overview: A satirical triptych that follows three young women, who all look identical. One girl stages a heist, another discovers her secret lover is also sleeping with her boyfriend, while the third sets out to save a woman from suicide.

results.title: A Happy Family
results.overview: Niki has two kids, two jobs, and no money. After a fire turns her life upside down, her children are placed in foster care. Banned from contact, she assumes a new identity risking everything to stay close to them.

results.title: AEW Double or Nothing 2026
results.overview: The 2026 Double or Nothing was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on May 24, 2026, at Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York City, New York, USA. It featured the first quarter-final matches of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournaments for both the men and women, as well as the long-anticipated AEW International Championship match between Don Callis Family members Kazuchika Okada (c) and Konosuke Takeshita. The show was headlined by Darby Allin (c) vs. MJF in a Title vs. Hair match for the AEW World Championship, where MJF would have to shave his head bald if he lost.
